question: What Windows installer TLS recovery policy should OpenClaw ship when npm fails with leaf-certificate verification errors during scripts/install.ps1?
rationale: The issue blocks first-time Windows setup, but retrying with strict SSL disabled or silently changing trust roots changes the installer trust boundary and needs maintainer security intent.

options.title: Security-reviewed CA remediation
options.body: Detect TLS verification failures and guide or apply explicit cafile or NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS remediation without automatically bypassing certificate verification.

options.title: Operator-approved strict-ssl fallback
options.body: Allow a clearly warned interactive-only strict-ssl=false retry while failing non-interactive installs with remediation instructions.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Keep the installer fail-closed and document npm CA repair, accepting that this setup path remains blocked for affected users.

recommendation.title: Security-reviewed CA remediation
recommendation.body: Detect TLS verification failures and guide or apply explicit cafile or NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS remediation without automatically bypassing certificate verification.
